open_points.subject: advance_run mapped value-output persistence
open_points.text: a mapped node's value output, once every element succeeded, is one StoredValue holding the canonical JSON array of the elements' values in element order, whose value_schema is the canonical array schema with the port's stored schema (M21: its value_schema, or for a many port the canonical array schema with it as items) as items, of the highest class among the elements, an empty list taking the highest class among the node's inputs, the mapped list and every other input, its value_digest is content_identity of a BytesContent holding the bytes and value_id content_identity of the StoredValueContent, published with put_value_bytes and written by runs when the list is first delivered, never in an element's own change — except the empty list, which the node's one NodeExecution over an empty list names and writes (A13 rule 6)
open_points.other_text: Every StoredValue runs derives as an input for delivery — the list element a mapped element receives, and a mapped node's value list when first delivered; never an output, which is written in the change of the NodeExecution that produces it, the [] output of a mapped node over an empty list included — MUST be written with record_change in a RecordRunProgressChange with no executions, status running and the run's waiting points and outputs unchanged before fit_port_value checks it and before execute_function_element or reach_operation_element receives it
open_points.question: Must a non-empty mapped node's aggregated value output be written in a separate RecordRunProgressChange with no executions when first delivered, or must every output be written in the change of the NodeExecution that produces it?
